tierA_configuration_recent_state_tension.definition: Tier A and either causal trailing expected_r <= 0.10 or trailing_win_rate < 0.45; these are frozen Tier-B recent-evidence requirements and are diagnostic only, not a removal rule.

management_rescue_candidate_mfe_ge_0_50R.note: hindsight diagnostic only; no eventual loss reached the existing +0.75R protected-state threshold

same_timestamp_capacity_regret.definition: a selected loss shared its exact decision timestamp with a candidate rejected by OPEN_RISK_BUDGET that later realized positive net_r

engineering_interpretation.secondary_surface: portfolio ordering and quality-adjusted capacity utilization
engineering_interpretation.right_tail_warning: The diagnostic flags are overlapping failure surfaces, not filters. Tier-A recent-state tension also contains economically important winners; suppressing it wholesale would violate right-tail preservation governance.
engineering_interpretation.next_test: bounded 112-day proposal memory with frozen 56-day reliability memory, 14-day validation, ranking, sizing, caps and management unchanged

hindsight_contract: Realized payoff, MFE and rejected-candidate outcomes are used only after historical decisions for attribution. They are not fed backward into eligibility, ranking or risk.
